description: A creature with the upper body of a woman and the lower body of a giant black spider, framed from the head down to the spider's abdomen. Her skin is a deep red-orange, her hair a dark blue-black tangle, and she holds a long crossbow level across her face, sighting toward the viewer's left. Below her waist a banded red torso joins a bulbous black spider abdomen, and long jointed legs outlined in pale cyan splay out to both sides. The background is a flat teal. Light from the left catches the legs and crossbow with pale highlights; the mood is a tense, poised ambush. Frame 1: a white star of light glints on the crossbow near her hands, very brief. Frame 2: the glint shrinks to a small spark, held a little longer. Frame 3: the glint jumps to her waist as a bright white flash where torso meets spider body, the longest hold. Frame 4: no glints, a short pause. The loop reads as a creature holding perfectly still, aiming, while points of light twinkle across her.
title: Spider-bodied woman aiming crossbow
